abstraction._comment: Claude sits at the CLASS rung: generalizes_to the LLM category above; specializes_to individual versioned model instances below (Claude 2, Claude 3 Opus/Sonnet/Haiku, Claude 3.5, Claude 4, Claude Fable 5). This is the deliberately mid-ladder anchor demonstrating wrappers can sit on any rung. Dialing the abstraction ladder downward reaches specific versioned models (instances); dialing upward reaches the LLM category (generic/class above). Each dial step is a REFRAME, not a zoom.

kernel._comment: Kernel admission rule (spec 2.3): bucket=corroborated AND certainty>=0.7 AND no ESTIMATE/PROXY tag. ALL facts are pending at sweep-1 emit time — no fact has been independently verified yet. Therefore the kernel is EMPTY at sweep-1. This is correct signal: kernel hardens as verifications land in sweep-2+. The kernel statement below describes what the kernel WILL contain once the highest-certainty facts are corroborated.
kernel.statement: Claude is a family (class) of large language models developed and operated by Anthropic (founded 2021-01-26); first announced and released 2023-03-14; trained using Constitutional AI methodology; available via claude.ai web, iOS app (App Store ID 6473753684, from 2024-05-01), and Android app (from 2024-07-16); class-level entity on the abstraction ladder between the LLM generic category above and specific versioned models below.

membrane._comment: All sweep-1 facts are pending (bucket=pending, no verification records yet). The membrane is the full fact population. Hardness h = B(bucket) x certainty per l0-membrane-proxy-v0.1 (disclosed: render proxy, not a measurement). B(pending)=0.55. Corroborated_soft and disputed are empty at sweep-1. Scars: none yet. Open questions carry the honest gaps and candidate edges.

frames._comment: Observer-global-kernel relevance weights — authored render estimates for group layout/prominence. Disclosed as proxies per L0_WRAPPER_SPEC §2.5 and UI_GUIDELINES §5.
frames._estimate_note: MANDATORY DISCLOSURE: these weights are AUTHORED RENDER ESTIMATES, not measured quantities and not substrate facts. Time 0.6: Claude has a meaningful lifecycle (2022 training, 2023 release, major versioned milestones, ongoing deprecations) but is not primarily a time-indexed artifact. Space 0.3: low — Claude is globally accessible via API/app; no strong geographic constraint. Knowledge 0.95: Claude is fundamentally a knowledge/language entity — its entire purpose is knowledge-frame interaction. Meaning 0.8: high — Claude is a meaning-making system (language, interpretation, values-via-CAI) but its physical substrate grounds it partially outside pure meaning. Any toy rendering these weights owes an adjacent estimate/proxy disclosure (UI_GUIDELINES §5).
